posts.caption:
Tired of the group chat plan that dies at "idk, whatever you want"?

Our new guide rounds up girls' night ideas in Salt Lake City and Utah County, sorted by mood: dinner and dessert, a dirty soda crawl, pottery and paint classes, escape rooms, live shows and cozy nights in.

Almost all of them work just as well with a soda as with a cocktail, so everyone in your group can say yes.

Pick one, send the link and put a date on the calendar. Read the full list, link in bio.

posts.caption:
Sitting in your car in the parking lot, wondering if you can just drive home? You're not the only one.

Walking in on your own isn't a sign you have no friends. It's how most friendships start.

Our guide covers what to do before you go, easy conversation openers, how to leave a chat without it feeling awkward, and the follow-up text that turns a nice chat into a real friend.

And research on the "liking gap" suggests the person you just talked to probably liked you more than you think.

Read it, then come to something on your own. We saved you a seat. Link in bio.

posts.title: How to Turn an Acquaintance Into a Real Friend
posts.caption:
You know plenty of people. But who could you call on a bad day?

Most acquaintances live inside a container: the gym, the office, the school pickup line. The friendship only grows when someone moves it somewhere new.

Our guide walks you through it step by step, with the exact words to use, from an easy invitation to the text that keeps things going between plans.

Pick one woman you already like and make the first move this week. Read the guide, link in bio.
